name: lazytools
description: LazyTools by The LazyDevs Inc.: small skills for Claude Code. help-me-decide turns open decisions into a multiple-choice page and the answers into an ADR. help-me-test turns a release into a tester checklist page and the results into a test report. help-me-review turns a pull request into a review checklist page and the verdicts into a review summary. catch-me-up turns your current session into a one-minute recap page with 2 or 3 ways to carry on. Requires Claude Code with Artifacts.
